chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام entered the bathhouse, and the bathhouse attendant said to him, “Shall we clear it for you?”
So he said, “No. Indeed, the believer is light in burden.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.المَئُونَةِ: burden, expense, or inconvenience placed on others
key_terms.نُخْلِيهِ: we make it vacant or clear it out

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach humility and consideration for others in daily social settings?
ai.summary: This hadith shows Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام declining special treatment in a public bathhouse. It teaches that a believer does not impose unnecessary burden on others and embodies humility and consideration in social conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.249 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) entered the bathhouse, the bathhouse attendant offered to clear it for him.
Imam (as) said: 'No, a believer is light in their burdens.’
